description: A single class session (period). Stored on the Ring's DID repository. Managed by the Class Rep through lifecycle transitions: scheduled → live → ended. Sessions may also be cancelled or rescheduled.

courseUri.description: AT URI of the parent app.changala.course record.

scheduledAt.description: Scheduled start time for this session.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the session.

createdBy.description: DID of the Class Rep who created this session.

topic.description: Optional topic or title for this session.

openedAt.description: Timestamp when session was opened (transitioned to live).

closedAt.description: Timestamp when session was closed (transitioned to ended).

keywordWindowExpiresAt.description: When the keyword submission window closes (typically 60 minutes after session ends).

rescheduledTo.description: New scheduled time if the session was rescheduled.
